entities.name: Query allene oxide cyclase
observations: 256-aa protein sequence; predicted molecular weight 27.30 kDa and pI 9.16.
Contains Pfam Allene_ox_cyc domain (PF06351.17) at residues 82–254.
Sequence matches curated plant allene oxide cyclases with 70.9–72.6% identity and approximately 69% query coverage.
Functional assignment is supported by homology and domain evidence; exact substrate specificity remains inferred from homologs.

entities.name: Plant allene oxide cyclase
observations: Curated UniProt homologs A2XID3, Q75KD7, and Q93ZC5 are annotated as allene oxide cyclases, EC 5.3.99.6.
These homologs participate in 12-oxo-phytodienoic acid production in jasmonate biosynthesis and are chloroplast localized.

entities.name: Allene oxide cyclization to OPDA
observations: Rhea RHEA:22592 records conversion of (9Z,13S,15Z)-12,13-epoxyoctadeca-9,11,15-trienoate to (9S,13S,15Z)-12-oxophyto-10,15-dienoate.
The reaction is the cyclization of a 12,13-allene oxide precursor to 12-oxo-phytodienoic acid (OPDA), without an added cofactor indicated in the retrieved annotation.
